scope: Same-boot, no-reset passive BNO observation with camera requested at 10Hz; no native motor stack or motor commands. Root acquired captures. This report uses only local immutable evidence.
headline: During this 120s camera-on interval, reported yaw changed +0.180 degrees and no large heading/gyro event recurred. Selected visible room snapshots showed no gross viewpoint rotation. This does not resolve the earlier motor-active falls.

camera.format: RGB888 1400x1050, compressed subscriber; frames saved at most 1Hz

summary.limits: Arrival/header clocks are recorded, not exposure-time proof; counts may be affected by subscriber load. Images provide scene evidence, not automatic heading ground truth.

visual_observations.agent: First frame almost black. In the three visible snapshots, dresser/basket/door/drying-rack edges appear in the same positions; no obvious large viewpoint change. Qualitative inspection of selected frames only, not calibrated orientation or a guarantee between frames.
visual_observations.root: Root independently viewed0000,0010,0056,0112 and reported fixed background placement appears unchanged after startup; people/objects at edge can change. Not calibrated angle truth.

comparison_to_prior_camera_off.prior_event_limit: Full300s including+58.5degree brief event remains in prior frozen report; operator not sure whether body moved. This list is descriptive, not a replacement pass.
comparison_to_prior_camera_off.interpretation: Small attitude change is similar in scale to earlier quiet intervals. Current maximum report gaps are larger, including one gyro sequence skip around 44.4s. This is a descriptive comparison, not randomized load attribution.

first_failed_attempt.interpretation: Camera launch could not find camera_ros in the original environment. No saved frames and reader was interrupted; not a successful camera-on comparison. Correct retry sources the existing ROS workspace. Original complete raw outputs retained.

raw_archive.contents: Both failed environment attempt and successful retry, all 113 JPEGs, IMU raw-read/packet/state, thermal, process exits and capture sources.

limits: No motor or hardware actions by this analyzer.
Camera callback/header and IMU packet receipts are host clocks, not synchronized exposure-time or physical sensor-age proof.
Initial stream drain includes sequence discontinuities; later one gyro sequence skip and 2 packet timeouts are disclosed. No failed reads, malformed packets or parse failures.
RV accuracy0 and gyro accuracy3 do not certify calibration or future readiness.
Visual review covers selected snapshots, not a measured angle or proof of every intermediate moment.
Sameboot/noreset is established by root run metadata; camera also has different loading/configuration than prior active sessions.
No causal claim that camera load, temperature, fusion, parser or policy caused or repaired prior falls.
Camera on means this standalone 10Hz camera and 1Hz-saving subscriber workload; it does not reproduce the full application, neural policy inference or motor load.
No calibration setting, gain, policy, production driver or hardware state was changed by the analysis.
review_scope: Owner full-stream numerical analysis and verification of every saved JPEG hash/raw archive member. Root independently inspected selected raw frames. No separate independent numerical peer is claimed for this addendum.
